Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is a structural proteomics study focused on chemical cross-linking (XL-MS) to provide distance restraints for protein structure modeling. It is not a differential expression or perturbation study comparing biological states (e.g., disease vs healthy or treated vs control), but rather a technical assessment of different cross-linking methodologies (BigX vs Smallx) across various protein targets. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
